record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: Find conditions on a unital Banach lattice algebra A such that if A is a sublattice and unital subalgebra of a larger Banach lattice algebra B then \(\sigma _A(x)=\sigma _B(x)\) for all \(x\in A\) . It would be of particular interest if some familiar order theoretic property of A , such as Dedekind completeness, were sufficient.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Banach lattice algebra is a real Banach algebra $A$ equipped with a lattice (Riesz space) structure such that $(A,\|\cdot\|)$ is a Banach lattice and the product is compatible with the order in the sense that $a,b\ge 0$ implies $ab\ge 0$. Assume throughout that $A$ is unital with positive unit. For $x\in A$, write $\sigma_A(x)$ for the spectrum of $x$ regarded as an element of the unital Banach algebra $A$ (i.e., the set of scalars $\lambda$ for which $\lambda 1_A - x$ is not invertible in $A$).

Determine general conditions on a unital Banach lattice algebra $A$ that guarantee the following spectral permanence property: whenever $B$ is a unital Banach lattice algebra containing $A$ as both a unital subalgebra and a sublattice (with the same unit and lattice operations inherited), one has
$$\sigma_A(x)=\sigma_B(x)\qquad\text{for every }x\in A.$$
In particular, decide whether some standard order-theoretic property of $A$ — for instance Dedekind completeness (every nonempty order-bounded subset has a supremum in $A$) — already suffices to force this equality for every such embedding $A\hookrightarrow B$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in surveys on Banach lattice algebras (Wickstead and related work). Recent literature on Banach lattice algebras (e.g., 2024 work on Banach lattice AM-algebras) continues to treat structural and spectral questions for Banach lattice algebras as active, without recording a general resolution of this spectral-permanence problem; no published solution was located.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattice algebras: some questions, but very few answers
status_evidence.snippet: Survey collecting open problems on Banach lattice algebras, including spectral questions for sublattice-subalgebra embeddings.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed among open questions on Banach lattice algebras.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattice AM-algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) study of structural properties of Banach lattice algebras, indicating the area remains active without a general spectral-permanence theorem.
status_evidence.claim: No general solution of the spectral-permanence problem appears in recent literature.
